# Sober: Sobriety Day Counter

> Sober is a free sobriety day counter app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Count days sober, check in daily, grow a bonsai garden and add a widget. No account needed.

## App

- [Sober: Sobriety Day Counter App for iPhone & Apple Watch](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sober/index.html.md): Sober is a free sobriety day counter app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Count days sober, check in daily, grow a bonsai garden and add a widget. No account needed.

## Guides

- [I Am Sober Alternatives: 5 Sobriety Apps Compared](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sober/i-am-sober-alternative.html.md): Five iPhone sobriety counters compared as I Am Sober alternatives: I Am Sober, Sober Time, Days Since, Sober Day and Sober. Facts as of October 2026.
- [Sobriety Milestones: What 30, 60, 90 Days and 1 Year Mean](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sober/sobriety-milestones.html.md): What sobriety milestones mean at 30, 60, 90 days and 1 year: chip traditions, what research shows after a month off alcohol, and how to mark each one.
